title: Health Services Admission Criteria for Respite and Short-Term Stays
content:
Each stay type of the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement has its own admission profile: a minimum guest age, an accepted care-point band, the diagnoses and risks it accepts, the health documents that must be on file and whether a Larkspur nurse assesses the guest on the arrival day. The criteria below are the figures Health Services publishes for every stay type.

## Age and care-point band

| Stay type | Minimum guest age on the arrival date (years) | Lowest care-point score accepted | Highest care-point score accepted |
|---|---|---|---|
| Independent Living Trial Stay | 62 | 0 | 0 |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Standard Care) | 55 | 0 | 25 |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Enhanced Care) | 55 | 26 | 50 |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Extensive Care) | 55 | 51 | 75 |
| Memory Care Respite Stay | 55 | 0 | 100 |
| Post-Hospital Recovery Stay | 55 | 0 | 75 |

## Diagnoses, risks and arrival assessment

| Stay type | Physician's diagnosis of dementia required | Guest with a wander or exit-seeking risk accepted | Hospital discharge summary required | Larkspur nurse care-point assessment on the arrival day |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Independent Living Trial Stay | No | No | No | No |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Standard Care) | No | No | No | Yes |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Enhanced Care) | No | No | No | Yes |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Extensive Care) | No | No | No | Yes |
| Memory Care Respite Stay | Yes | Yes (only in a secured neighborhood) | No | Yes |
| Post-Hospital Recovery Stay | No | No | Yes | Yes |

## Health documents

| Stay type | Physician's report of health status required before check-in | Tuberculosis screening result required with the documents | Maximum age of the documents on the arrival date (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Independent Living Trial Stay | No | No | 30 |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Standard Care) | Yes | Yes | 30 |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Enhanced Care) | Yes | Yes | 30 |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Extensive Care) | Yes | Yes | 30 |
| Memory Care Respite Stay | Yes | Yes | 30 |
| Post-Hospital Recovery Stay | Yes | Yes | 7 |

The maximum age applies to the health documents named for the stay type, the physician's report or the hospital discharge summary.

## Notes on the bands

- The three Assisted Living Respite Stay care levels divide the care-point scale without overlap: Standard Care 0 to 25, Enhanced Care 26 to 50, Extensive Care 51 to 75. A score of 25 falls in Standard Care and a score of 26 in Enhanced Care; 50 falls in Enhanced Care and 51 in Extensive Care.
- The Independent Living Trial Stay accepts only a score of 0; its guests must be at least 62, against 55 for every other stay type.
- The Post-Hospital Recovery Stay carries the shortest document validity, 7 calendar days, against 30 for every other stay type.
